## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: resolve-conflicts SKILL.md is updated to handle whichever conflict-signal shape is chosen

## Description
Update `plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md` to document the canonical CONFLICT_DATA schema (single shared schema produced by `_emit_conflict_data` in `merge-helpers.sh`) used by BOTH merge modes, and reference the regression test from S7-T1 as the contract anchor.

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md` (MODIFY)

## Documentation Updates Required

1. Add or extend a `## CONFLICT_DATA Contract` section describing:
   - Single line format: `CONFLICT_DATA <json>`
   - Fields: `branch` (string), `base_branch` (string), `conflicted_files` (string[]), `resolution_strategy` (string)
   - Both merge modes (direct and PR) emit the same schema via shared `_emit_conflict_data` helper
   - PR-mode-specific resolution_strategy values: `pr-auto-merge`, `gh-pr-create`
   - Direct-mode-specific values: `git-merge-no-ff`, `git-rebase-recovery`
2. Reference the regression test as the contract anchor: `tests/integration/test-conflict-data-schema-parity.sh`
3. Note: skill consumers MUST NOT branch on merge strategy — the schema is identical

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CONFLICT_DATA Contract section present
  Verify: grep -q 'CONFLICT_DATA Contract\|## CONFLICT_DATA' plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md
- [ ] All four schema fields documented
  Verify: for k in branch base_branch conflicted_files resolution_strategy; do grep -qF "$k" plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Regression test referenced as contract anchor
  Verify: grep -qF 'test-conflict-data-schema-parity.sh' plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md
- [ ] Both resolution_strategy value families documented (pr-auto-merge and git-merge-no-ff)
  Verify: grep -qF 'pr-auto-merge' plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'git-merge-no-ff' plugins/dso/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
